booking.baggage: Each: 1 cabin bag + 1 small handbag, 2 checked bags (23 kg each)

stays.name: Onyado Nono Nara Natural Hot Spring

days.title: Fly to Japan

items.text: Leave home
BA005 departs Heathrow T5 (arrives Haneda T3 next day 10:55)

notes: Preparation: set up Suica / Pasmo digital IC cards for JR lines before you go.

items.text: Land at Haneda T3
Tokyo Monorail (Haneda Express is fastest) to Hamamatsucho, 13–18 min
JR Yamanote Line (Outer Loop) to Shinjuku, about 25 min
Check in to hotel
Shake off jet lag: Shinjuku Gyoen or Shinjuku Central Park
Yakitori dinner in Omoide Yokocho
Bakery or kissaten breakfast (e.g. Sawamura in NEWoMan Shinjuku)
Meiji Jingu Shrine and Yoyogi Park, then Harajuku / Omotesando
Shibuya Crossing and Shibuya Sky
Ramen or tonkatsu in Shibuya/Shinjuku (e.g. Tonkatsu Tonki or Tatsunoya)

days.title: Azusa to Matsumoto Castle

items.text: Limited Express Azusa from Shinjuku (about 2 h 30 min to Matsumoto)
Walk ~15 min or taxi to Nunoya Ryokan to drop bags
Matsumoto Castle, Nawate-dori (Frog Street) and Nakamachi-dori
Shinshu soba and Sanzoku-yaki

notes: Azusa departure time is typical; check the timetable.

days.title: Day trip to Kamikochi

items.text: Kamikochi Line to Shin-Shimashima, then bus to Kamikochi (about 1 h 40 min total)
Hike the Azusa River: Taisho Pond, Kappa Bridge, Myojin Pond
Back to Matsumoto; ryokan or Matsumoto Brewery Tap Room
TODO: ask Nunoya Ryokan staff to ship suitcases by takkyubin (parcel delivery) ahead of the Nakasendo hike
Shinshu beef teppanyaki or horsemeat sashimi (basashi)

notes: Nunoya Ryokan confirmed by email that they can arrange parcel delivery at the hotel; speak to a member of staff.

days.title: Torii-toge Pass: Narai to Yabuhara

items.text: JR Chuo Main Line local 1824M from Matsumoto (bound for Nakatsugawa), arrive Narai 08:44
Coffee and something to eat in Narai
Hike Narai over Torii-toge Pass to Yabuhara station (about 6 km, 3-3.5 h)
JR Chuo Main Line local from Yabuhara to Kiso-Fukushima (or the 14:27)
Hotel shuttle meets you at Kiso-Fukushima station to Komanoyu

notes: Fixed from notes: "Matsumoto status" read as Matsumoto station.
Trains are not hourly: other Matsumoto departures 06:32 and 10:20.
Recheck the Oct 25 JR timetable closer to travel (JR Central publishes next month's schedule monthly).

days.title: Tsumago to Magome over the pass

items.text: Walk or shuttle to Kiso-Fukushima station (1 h, 5 km)
JR Chuo Line (local or Shinano Express) to Nagiso
Hike Nagiso to Tsumago-juku (~4 km, ~1 h)
Nakasendo trail over Magome Pass to Magome-juku (~8 km, ~3 h); bear bells, Tateba Tea House
Check in at Magome Chaya; traditional dinner
Hike Magome-juku via the Ochiai Cobblestone Path to Nakatsugawa (~9 km, 3–3.5 h)
Stroll the old post town merchant streets
Check in at hatago STAY Shinmachi
Hida beef and kurikinton chestnut sweets

days.title: Trains to Nara and the deer park

items.text: JR Shinano Limited Express, Nakatsugawa to Nagoya (~50 min)
Nozomi Shinkansen, Nagoya to Kyoto (~35 min)
JR Miyakoji Rapid, Kyoto to JR Nara (~45 min)
Arrive Nara; 1 min from West Exit to check in
Hot springs, then Nara Park and the deer
Todai-ji (Great Buddha Hall) and Nigatsu-do
Kasuga Taisha through the lantern forest; Naramachi machiya
Local izakaya or kaki-no-ha sushi
45 min train to Kyoto; early start at Fushimi Inari
Nintendo Museum?
Kiyomizu-dera, Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka, Gion and Higashiyama
Pontocho Alley by the Kamogawa, then train back to Nara

days.title: Day trip to Osaka

items.text: 45 min train to Osaka
Osaka Castle
World-famous for matcha, Byodoin Phoenix Hall
Afternoon: ?

notes: Byodoin is in Uji, not Osaka. Kept as written.

days.title: Shinkansen to Odawara Castle

items.text: JR to Kyoto, then Hikari Shinkansen direct to Odawara (~2 h)
Walk 5 min to Ryokan Plum to drop bags
Odawara Castle
Odawara Fishermen's Wharf

notes: Fixed from notes: dinner was a pasted train line; used the itinerary's dinner (Odawara Fishermen's Wharf).

days.title: Up to Hakone-Yumoto

items.text: Hakone Tozan Line, Odawara to Hakone-Yumoto (~15 min)
Drop bags at RoheN (5 min walk from the station)
Japan Samurai Festival
Local dining

notes: Fixed from notes: dinner said "Station (~2 hrs)", pasted by mistake; used the itinerary's "Local dining".

days.title: Daimyo procession, then Yokohama
days.breakfast: RoheN / Hakone Cafe by the station

items.text: Lock up bags by the station
Hakone Daimyo Gyoretsu procession until 14:30: 170+ costumed samurai, chants and musket demos
Hakone Tozan to Odawara, JR Tokaido Line to Yokohama (~40 min)
Check in at Sotetsu Hotels The Splaisir Yokohama
Minato Mirai waterfront and dinner in Chinatown

notes: Fixed from notes: start was "Odawara"; you wake up in Hakone-Yumoto (RoheN).
Fixed from notes: tonight's stay is Sotetsu Splaisir Yokohama, not RoheN.

days.title: Fly home

items.text: Early check-out from the Splaisir
Keikyu Airport Express from Yokohama to Haneda (~25 min)
BA006 departs Haneda T3
Land at Heathrow T5 19:10 UK time

notes: Fixed from notes: 4 Nov is a Wednesday, not a Tuesday.
Fixed from notes: the "Stay: RoheN" line was wrong; tonight is the flight home.
